evidence.title: The Laws of Context Allocation: Causal Measurement and Closed-Loop Orchestration in Generative Search

summary: Researchers introduced a set of principles dubbed the "Laws of Context Allocation" that formalize how to measure the causal impact of contextual inputs in generative search systems. The work also proposes a closed‑loop orchestration approach to dynamically adjust context, aiming to improve relevance and efficiency of AI‑driven search results.
title: New Framework Defines Context Allocation, Causal Measurement, and Closed‑Loop Orchestration for Generative Search
